what: plan batch 0 of L37-match_ceil.jsonl, written alone (census_run.py --canary-only), to compare with the same batch written on another card (census_tools.py canary)

prompts.walk: Give me three tips for a long walk.

meta.push: add: dose x the neuron's write ceiling (s_l sqrt(D) ||w_post * unit(W_down[:, n])||, the most it can write by itself) along unit(w_post * W_down[:, n]) (a control: dose x the ceiling of the neuron it is paired with, along unit(w_post * r), r isotropic), at the stream leaving the layer, every word-piece but the start mark
meta.controls: unit(w_post * r), r isotropic: the reference's random down column through the post-feed-forward norm
meta.ceilings: each pushed answer records its unit's write ceiling (`ceiling`; a control's is that of the neuron it is paired with, `ref_neuron`), the push's own unit

read_gain.read_by: the next layer's input norm (the final norm after the last layer)

meta.doses_from: two counts of each neuron's own write ceiling that differ by layer: at each layer, the pushes that move the next word-piece by 1.0 and by 1.4 nats (the median over 128 of the layer's neurons), as the census's fine dose pilot measured them there. soft_ceil's fixed counts passed at layer 39 (as the pages count them) and failed at layer 38, where its lower dose moved the next word-piece too little to carry a lead alone; a push of about 1 nat is what break_rel's lower dose makes where it is calibrated. Calibrated at layers 33-38 by a trial of each (13 November 2026, 1,022 fresh neurons against 1,024 controls, three gates fixed before any was read: the whole reading, the lower dose's answers alone, the neurons whose text survives as the controls' does), all six passing all three, layer 37 by 0.001 on one gate; not at layer 32, where its trial failed (the lower dose's answers alone did not carry a neuron's words from one half of the questions to the other), and tried at no other layer

self_test.table: 16 pieces x 65,536 bf16 scales on cuda:0
